# ledger inclusion proof

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ledgerInclusionProof`](gmeow-ledgerInclusionProof.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ledgerInclusionProof>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/attestation`](../../slices/attestation.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A cryptographic inclusion proof for a transaction, event, or transparency log entry. Domain-free: applies to [`LedgerTransaction`](../classes/gmeow-LedgerTransaction.md), [`LedgerEvent`](../classes/gmeow-LedgerEvent.md), [`TransparencyLogEntry`](../classes/gmeow-TransparencyLogEntry.md), and [`Block`](../classes/gmeow-Block.md).

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; `?` -> [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:ledgerInclusionProof`](gmeow-ledgerInclusionProof.md) from `?` to [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to carry the cryptographic inclusion proof (e.g. a Merkle proof) for a ledger transaction, event, block, or transparency-log entry — the domain-free evidence that the record is present in its log or chain.

### Avoid when

- Avoid reading a present inclusion proof as correctness — it proves inclusion, NOT real-world truth (module boundaries) — and avoid it for the verdict of checking the proof (that is a [`gmeow:VerificationResult`](../classes/gmeow-VerificationResult.md)).

### How to use

- Attach the proof literal to the transaction, event, block, or transparency-log entry; the proof is verified in the solver layer ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)), which produces a [`gmeow:VerificationResult`](../classes/gmeow-VerificationResult.md) rather than asserting truth.

### Examples

- ex:rekorEntry [`gmeow:ledgerInclusionProof`](gmeow-ledgerInclusionProof.md) "<merkle-proof-base64>".
